scripts.source:
-- One round: 2d6 + skill against 2d6 + 7. Winning by 5 or more is a
-- critical hit that doubles the damage; a tie wounds nobody.
function run(story, args)
  local v = story.vars
  local hero = dice(2, 6) + v.destreza
  local bandit = dice(2, 6) + 7
  fx.add("ronda", 1)
  if hero > bandit then
    local damage = 2 + (args.arma or 0)
    if hero - bandit >= 5 then damage = damage * 2 end
    fx.add("vigor_bandido", -damage)
    fx.set("ultimo_golpe", damage)
    if v.vigor_bandido - damage <= 0 then
      fx.score(50)
      fx.go("victoria")
    end
  elseif bandit > hero then
    fx.add("vigor", -3)
    fx.set("ultimo_golpe", -3)
    if v.vigor - 3 <= 0 then fx.go("derrota") end
  else
    fx.set("ultimo_golpe", 0)
  end
end

-- You can only flee after holding out for a few rounds and with strength left to run.
function check(story, args)
  return story.vars.ronda >= (args.rondas or 2) and story.vars.vigor >= 4
end

function run(story, args)
  if story.items.pocion then
    fx.take("pocion")
    fx.add("vigor", 4 + dice(1, 4))
  end
end

text.en: A bandit blocks your way through the gorge. Before you fight, take the measure of your skill.
text.es: Un bandido te cierra el paso en el desfiladero. Antes de luchar, mide tu destreza.

label.en: Draw your sword (roll one die and add 6)

text.en: The bandit swings his scimitar. Each round pits 2d6 plus your skill against 2d6 plus 7.
text.es: El bandido gira su cimitarra. Cada asalto enfrenta 2d6 más tu destreza contra 2d6 más 7.

text.en: The bandit falls and the pass lies open.
text.es: El bandido cae y el paso queda libre.

text.en: You sink to your knees. The bandit makes off with your purse.
text.es: Caes de rodillas. El bandido se queda con tu bolsa.

text.en: You slide down the slope and get away, bruised but alive.
text.es: Te deslizas ladera abajo y escapas, magullado pero vivo.
